Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 12 familiarisation trials per block (with feedback, 400 ms)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 360 trials total (120 per block: 60 match, 60 mismatch; 20 match per referent, 10 mismatch per referent pair)

Trial_Structure.ITI: 500 ms blank screen at trial start
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 400 ms (familiarisation trials only; no feedback on experimental trials)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: 3 neutral faces (Chicago Face Database, Ma et al., 2015), non-face features removed, direct gaze
Stimulus_Properties.Label: English words: You, Friend, Stranger (Calibri bold white font)

exp1.detail: Learning phase: each face-label match presented for 20 s. Response keys: c (match), m (mismatch). Database file corresponds to the paper's Experiment 1 (individual differences approach, neurotypical University of Kent students; paper: 59 recruited, 1 excluded for <33% accuracy -> 58 analyzed, 13 male / 45 female, age 18-27 M=19.22). Data contain 48 participants x 360 trials; stage-4 verification (2026-08) confirmed the full public OSF archive holds per-participant exports for exactly these 48 participants (48 csv/psydat/log each; the in-repo *_Raw/ folder was replaced by the downloaded br98c-osfstorage-archive), so the remaining ~10 participants' trial-level data were never publicly released and raw backfill is exempted; CSV N caliber set to data (48/48/0) with paper caliber in CSV Note. Data demographics are partial (11M/5F of 48; ages 20-49 for 8 participants). Monitor 'Dell' from pre-registration (not stated in paper main text). Method source: paper full text (REF/ Smith_2024_Cortex.html) + pre-registration (OSF).
